description: Check deliverability of emails you already have. Billable: about $0.005 per email submitted (every address is billed, whatever the verdict) at the Tier 0 list price. Accounts can pay a different rate: get_balance returns this account's prices, and every response reports what was actually spent in cost.amount_charged_usd. This is the one operation where every submitted address is billed: the verdict is the deliverable. An address generate_email returned as valid is already verified, so validating it again only adds cost.

emails.description: Email addresses to validate. Each one is billed.

name: validate_email
title: Validate email deliverability
